product: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 public COG DSM
description: Runtime-selected fixed-source COG ranges, not a bundled worldwide raster. Strong ETag and range identity checked per source object.
physical_reference: EGM2008 orthometric H in metres (vertical CRS EPSG:3855); DSM including vegetation/buildings
sampling: Native v1: 30m source sampled to a 1/4096-degree lattice (~27.2m north-south). Display overview v2: quarter-degree 129x129 nodes on a 1/512-degree lattice (~217m north-south). Both use canonical source posts; derived spacing does not improve source accuracy.
fallback: Native and display have separate sampling contracts; see native_fallback and display_overview. Exact existing native/fine atlas precedence is retained.
limitations: DSM includes buildings/vegetation; it is not bare-earth or surveyed runway terrain.
No full global collection is bundled; optional source coverage and availability vary.
Failed optional native owner outcomes are retained until restart; epoch budget exhaustion uses coarse fallback.
The 30m source, ~27.2m native lattice and ~217m display resampling are different quantities; neither derived lattice establishes measured accuracy.
Existing coarse EGM2008 geoid interpolation and approximate regional DHHN2016/GCG-to-global datum transitions remain.
Display overview coverage is finite; coarse world terrain remains beyond it.
No aircraft, surveyed airport, operational navigation or training-fidelity acceptance is established by source integration.
edition_scope: Existing fixed public AWS collection identified as 2021 by this integration; not a claim to serve the latest CDSE release. Per-object ETag/size/range identity is retained during decoding.
native_fallback: Valid regional triangles, then canonical available Copernicus physical samples plus existing world geoid, then bundled one-degree baseline. Failed owner outcomes remain fixed within the stream epoch; no display overview enters native cells.

display_overview.native_effect: none; display-only data never enter native contact grids, source codes, controls or simulation state
display_overview.composition: Valid regional physical/geoid nodes first; otherwise available Copernicus H plus existing coarse world N. Omit the entire composed cell if any node remains unavailable; do not create internal coarse-filled gaps.
display_overview.display_priority: Exact existing fine/current-world atlas first, complete display overview next, coarse world last; exterior display transitions preserve exact authoritative atlas samples.
display_overview.lifecycle: Load only after current terrain readiness. During current native-terrain loading, cancel in-flight overview work but retain completed display cells; Review, flat mode, reset/new flight and disposal cancel and clear. Stale generations cannot install.
display_overview.server_priority: At most one overview job shares the two native/service cell slots, reserving one for foreground v1 demand; v1 may use both when no overview is active.
display_overview.client_status: API available; separate dependent display client not included or activated
